Light pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Fanny Ardant ®
rows.Bloom: Light pink, darker center. Moderate fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.

Upright. Large, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm).
